historical_reviews.deepseek: Read-only command is plausible but cannot decide expected alerts.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds platform inventory, baseline and per-alert user disposition.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Policy and version rows explain configuration but do not replace current alert state.

original_test_intent: Enumerate every current NVSM warning and critical alert with all expected devices connected and verify each alert is either absent or explicitly approved for the platform state.
original_method: Pin/install approved NVSM version; verify complete PSU/network/device inventory; preserve existing diagnostics instead of clearing; run exact `nvsm show alerts` read-only with host/time; retain full hierarchy/status/health fields; compare each alert to approved baseline/waiver and correlate to subsystem logs without mutating state.
manual_activity: Platform owner supplies the expected-alert/waiver register and decides each warning/critical disposition; collection/comparison are automated.
required_inputs: Expected alert baseline and active waivers with owner/expiry
safety_requirements: Do not suppress, acknowledge or repair alerts
Preserve unknown/duplicate/stale entries and raw hierarchy
agent_execution_scope: Map every entry to baseline/waiver and corroborating evidence

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The read-only command is applicable, but package provenance, complete inventory and an expected-alert oracle are missing.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal command from the approved NVSM build and compare every returned alert to the governed register.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All subsystems and the connect-all-devices precondition are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a normalized alert table with subsystem identity, severity, status, timestamps and waiver disposition while retaining raw output.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes expected objective and preserves diagnostics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A zero-row result is valid only after inventory completeness and command health are proven.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: NVSM alert lifecycle/schema can vary by release; stale alerts may require separate diagnosis rather than deletion.

project_override_considerations: Project owner defines allowable alerts and time-bounded waivers; absence of an oracle cannot be treated as PASS.
expected_evidence: NVSM build/package provenance and host identity

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently target expected active alerts; the missing expected-alert register is a project input, while log clearing is an unsafe step rejected at review layer.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Package and alert baseline are provisionable; read-only collection can proceed afterward.

review_improvement: Requires explicit ownership of every warning/critical alert and prevents clearing evidence to manufacture a clean result.
independent_technical_reasoning: An empty alert list can mean a healthy system, an incomplete inventory or a broken management stack. Device completeness, command success and the governed waiver register must all be established before absence or presence of alerts has acceptance meaning.
